metadata.derivation: Derived by SpektraLab from kodak_vision3_250d (dyes and structure): Eterna 250D (8563/8663, daylight 5500K): curves from the Fujifilm Motion Picture Film Manual (Ref. KB-0707E) (exposed to 5400K); no spectral data published, so the spectral sensitivity is the Vision3 250D base's. Characteristic curves digitized from the manufacturer datasheet (Status M curves on the ISO 250 speed point, unmixed with the base dyes; spectral sensitivity is the base's); minimum density from the datasheet; hanatos2025 adaptation data are the base's.
